claim: Try a playable sample battle in one click, then reset it or start a real game.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh 1440x900 browser context; assert the action and outcome note are above the fold; click once; assert seeded players, persistent banner, reset, exit, and ?demo=1

claim: Ward shares a team shield and Surge boosts every team strike.
sandbox: fresh /demo room; build Ward to 40; share both roles; assert shield and boost state

claim: Demo play uses isolated sample state and does not save to real game preferences or analytics.
sandbox: preseed real browser keys; use and reset /demo; assert namespaced session state, unchanged real keys, no cookies/page-view write, and same-origin traffic

claim: The sample reloads and remains playable offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh 390px context; load /demo twice; wait for service-worker control; set offline; reload; build and share Ward

claim: A real room disappears when its host disconnects.
where: landing operational facts, privacy page, README
sandbox: start at /demo; create and join a real room; close host; assert the old code rejects a new join

claim: The game is free and needs no account.
sandbox: fresh context; assert free/no-account copy, no password or payment flow, no cookies, and same-origin requests

claim: Role and battle cues use words, shapes, position, markers, and accessible values instead of color alone.
sandbox: fresh /demo room; assert Ward and Surge words/symbols, distinct positions, markers, and named progress values

claim: The interface supports keyboard play, visible focus, 390px screens, reduced motion, and 44px touch targets.
sandbox: fresh 390px keyboard context plus reduced-motion context; assert skip focus, no overflow, touch sizes, motion duration, and zero serious/critical axe findings

claim: Ground markers, high contrast, and reduced motion stay in the browser and are not sent to the room server.
sandbox: fresh real host; change all display settings; assert localStorage values, same-origin requests, and no setting names in WebSocket frames

claim: Real rooms support 2–8 controllers with balanced Ward and Surge roles and a three-minute round.
sandbox: start at /demo; create a real room; join eight controllers; reject the ninth; assert balanced roles and a 180-second start

claim: The server stores only an anonymous daily page count, and demo visits are not counted.
sandbox: fresh /demo request log plus isolated SQLite backend integration test

claim: Page-view overload protection admits a 20-request burst per client, then returns 429 with Retry-After.
sandbox: fresh backend and unique forwarded client address; send 25 concurrent page views; assert exactly 20 HTTP 204 and 5 HTTP 429 with Retry-After
